title: Emrys and the Vector
author: Felix Vasquez
blurb: Mirabel Eriksen, a xenolinguist who can no longer dream in human languages, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before Earth's last transmission loop ends.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
